authority: Explicit user delegation to select and execute remaining planned local repairs; these precise options are chosen by executor under that authority, not claimed as earlier separately signed text

D-S01-01.rule: Current active, not forced-change actor must have current DB permission and strictly outrank target. Equal/higher rank and administrative self-target denied; applies reset/enable/disable/delete and role change. Role grants must remain strictly below actor rank; no custom role binding enabled. Target and actor rows locked in ascending id order in same business transaction, current user-role grants checked. Account write, refresh revocation and strict audit atomic.
D-S01-01.emergency: No remote bypass or emergency reset route; out-of-band recovery remains excluded/unimplemented. At least protected SUPER_ADMIN cannot be disabled/deleted/reset by a peer.
D-S01-01.compatibility: Existing URLs/body shapes; previously unsafe requests now403; local candidate only, no deployment/migration

D-S01-02.rule: All other authenticated routes deny403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED; refresh remains existing body-token endpoint but cannot bypass resulting restricted access. Revalidate current locked user and force flag during password write; require actual old password for normal change. No IDB/outbox clearing.
D-S01-02.transaction: Password write + refresh revocation + strict audit same tx; any failure rolls back all. No TTL change or security version in this task.

D-S01-04.events: Self normal/force password change, admin reset, any system-role binding change, disable, enable and soft-delete each increments user securityVersion and required refresh revocation in same strict-audit transaction. Current active user/version is checked for every native Bearer request; revoked tokens rejected immediately on subsequent authentication, regardless of JWT expiry. Already authorized in-flight ordinary requests follow their existing tx; account/password commands additionally recheck version in locked tx.
D-S01-04.schema: Add users.security_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT0 with nonnegative CHECK; retain field on rollback. Never rewrite existing migrations, no applied down migration. Old existing users0 preserved, no historical audits modified.
D-S01-04.legacy: JWT missing or mismatched securityVersion denied401, no grace; explicit new login/current valid refresh obtains versioned access. Candidate Web Bearer/body interface and actual TTL unchanged. Legacy target upgrade/logout not executed; old apps that ignore version cannot safely rollback and must be contained, target compatibilityNOT_RUN.
D-S01-04.issuance: After login conditional state reset, locked current row must still match originally checked password hash and version before signing and inserting refresh in same tx; password reset may not turn old-password login into a new-version credential. Refresh current-user lock + revocation existing strict transaction reused.
D-S01-04.logout: Existing family logout contract retained; this task does not claim immediate per-access logout revocation or per-session family JWTs.
D-S01-04.deployment: Local candidate/owned DB only. No production/target migration, account operation or real recovery. Retain columns/deny incompatible old app instead of deleting version guard.
D-S01-04.risk: Immediate old-JWT cutover requires login/refresh and target release validation. Existing in-flight ordinary command boundaries are not globally serialized by auth middleware; current-command locks/CAS still apply.

T-RP-12.rule: All queues/conflicts/dead letters persist per authenticated actor, hidden from other actors and bootstrap/anonymous state. No automatic payload deletion on logout, switch, TTL, quota or failed move. Recovery requires same current actor and fresh authorized project/permission snapshot; no browser-origin data assigned to first login. Pending immutable payload may be exported only by authenticated recorded owner, explicit discard must be separately confirmed and recorded locally. Server mirror cache is not a draft; current owner/permission/project projection and authorization snapshot at most five minutes old. Definitive401/403/404 invalidates fallback; stale login generation cannot read/write/delete newer partition. Offline inability to know server revocation is bounded by five minute cache lease; target policy acceptance not claimed.

T-RP-09-RP11.rule: Use existing tokenStore actorId + loginGeneration, separate from refresh tokenRevision. Verified authenticated profile activates owner partition; bootstrapping merely pauses and hides, anonymous logout deactivates matching generation only without payload deletion. Capture owner/generation before every asynchronous operation; IndexedDB transaction checks current authority and persistent generation fence before any write. Device id partitioned by actor. API does not accept inferred owner.

T-RP-01.rule: IDB version4 upgrade copies legacy rows to immutable quarantine source envelopes and verifies canonical values/counts in same native upgrade transaction. Explicit recorded outbox.userId, deadLetter.userId or pendingDraft.value.userId matching original key permits copy to exactly that actor partition only; unknown records and unproved kv remain quarantined. Do not infer owner from first login, project membership, content or current token. No unknown claim/export/discard UI enabled without independently attributable owner proof; current user may see counts only. All original stores remain; no automatic cleanup or deletion. Existing new-owner key wins on collision, full original remains in quarantine. Abort/blocked close is retryable, no successful upgrade claim before commit. Old connections must close on versionchange; blocked aborts pending upgrade request, retry only after blocker releases. New candidate never exposes old store contents. Rollback to owner-capable client only; do not clear IDB.

T-RP-12-RP11-T03.rule: Move pending payload to conflicts/dead letters and delete original only in one owner-fenced native IDB transaction; failure/abort/quota leaves original. Retry known rejected immutable command by atomic move back; conflict retain-local creates explicit new intent/current server baseline, atomically after current owner/permission/project authorization recheck. Unknown/expired receipts never automatic new-key retry (handled RP12). User-visible recovery panel supports original payload inspection/export, retry, server/local choice and confirmed explicit discard; each reads current authenticated owner + fresh authorization and records local user action in same tx before removing last copy. Missing owner proof cannot be claimed/exported/discarded via application. No automatic TTL/quota delete or bulk clear. Owned unsent draft lacking project may be viewed/exported only after fresh /me actor match, not retried until linked/current authorization; server snapshots hidden unless current project/read grant. Local actions retained, audit is local IDB evidence and not server audit.

T-RP-11.rules: Serialize all backup/cleanup by OS process lease flock; crash releases lock, never steals living lock. Unique caller runId bound to DB/kind/sources; same completed id verified/idempotent, different binding conflict; in-progress orphan preserved. Dump custom format validates pg_restore listing/hash. Actual directory file snapshot rsync --link-dest only fully hash verified previous published pair; no in-place/chmod published links; validate file bytes/metadata/symlinks and same-FS stage rename. Both paths complete before atomic pair.json published/latest pointer; interrupted partial unpublished, oldlatest unchanged. Retention only validates published pair and removes both underlease, minlast two/latest/pins/last verified protected, unknown legacy/orphans preserved; no automatic orphan deletion. Defaults daily30weekly84monthly365predeployneverexpire, target budget/retentionactual external. Explicit no claim common write-point yet; RP19 barrier refinement.

T-RP-02-RP12.rules: Extend existing approved backend v1, no business backend behavior change. Never reserve legacy ambiguous rows. For fresh compliant producer persist original device/project/key/canonical semantic hash and reserving stage before any reserve request; no push until same binding handle/hash/window has committed in IDB. Reserve response loss may repeat identical reservation only when durable evidence shows no push was possible. Before push persist pushed stage, freeze command/body; unknown/expired/receipt loss never auto reserve/rekey. Query same original handle/hash/device binding after response loss/partial500, validate full result identity/hash/handle before ack. Pending unexpired bound command can retry exact key/body; known applied ack/delete atomic; conflict/rejected move last copy atomic with all transport identity preserved. Returned duplicate/missing/unknown key/status/type/error leaves unconfirmed copies. No endless automatic retries; at most one query/recovery stage per sync for uncertain items, user-visible state retained. Current owner/generation guards before every HTTP and IDB stage; each original device group envelope bounded by actual complete UTF8 JSON including receipt fields.

T-RP-12-RP12.rules: Unknown/expired/legacy/oversize/dependency states remain original-owner pending copies, explain cannot safely execute; original export/confirmed discard use current authorized recovery path. Unknown/expired are not conflict/new-key license. Explicit conflict-local creates fresh new-intent metadata, clears prior handle/hash/window; rejected retry carries identical original receipt metadata. Local owner original unchanged until definitive acknowledged commit.

T-RP-04-RP08.rule: Repeatable-read current-auth DB snapshot ACL sha256 binds actor/systemRole/securityVersion, sorted permissions, project membership role/joinedAt/manager and projectionVersion. Missing/stale client aclVersion forces current-scope full snapshot; signed pagination fingerprint rejects after ACL change. Client invalidates old authorization before changed-snapshot writes, atomically publishes mirror+ACL+cursor at final page; partial snapshot cannot authorize fallback. Five minute offline authorization lease. Safe watermark/epoch provided later by RP13, not proven here.

T-RP-12-RP08.rule: Preserve original queue/conflict/dead copies. Check current fresh write project/entity/action/capability before any reserve/query/push. Denied items retain scopeBlocked marker; original payload/key/binding untouched. Returning grant never auto-sends a previously isolated item; explicit same-binding recheck required. No projection leaks or guessed owner assignment.

D-S01-06.rules: Same current approved shared manager command from RP07. Registration update+write and projects.manage_members+manage_members, exact base, active sameproject target, keep owner/prior membership, all profile/manager/member/audit state atomic. Current native JWT/DB, no mock/injected actor acceptance.

D-S01-05.rules: No registration-wide read/write exception. Ordinary list/stats/detail require ACTIVE membership (leftAt null), alive registration subtype and read capability plus registrations.view; managerId alone without active membership is not exception. Detail/project profile are registration-owned projection; linked tasks/taskcounts require tasks.view, milestones requires milestones.view, phases requires project_phases.view, member profiles require projects.view and active members only, regulatory links require regulatory_documents.view. SUPER_ADMIN nonmember allowed with audit elevated and permissionCode, list/stats access logs sensitive scope. Updates/profile require registrations.update AND write capability; stage requires registrations.change_stage AND transition capability. Current actor status/deleted/forced/securityVersion/current DB role grants rechecked in same tx/snapshot; writer locks actor/project, rechecks alive subtype/currentmember and applies strict audit atomically. No caller-supplied visibility override. Stage lock+currentstate no stale edge. Templates remain global active public template catalog (registrations.view), no projectdata. Creator uses existing registrations.create only; new creator becomes OWNER to ensure project scoped readability; no implicit activation. Manager transfer existing D6 unchanged mandatory exactbaseline/membertarget.

D-S01-08.rules: ID-preserving tasks/milestones array upserts, omission always preserves originals. Explicit deletedTaskIds/deletedMilestoneIds only legal delete intent; all changed-child aggregates exact baseUpdatedAt and each existing update item baseUpdatedAt for child CAS. New records server-generated IDs, never hard delete/recreate. Current actor/version/grants + project/member capability rechecked inside locked command. Distinct create/update/delete and status/assign system/cap guards. References newly written must same-project/live; existing anomalies retained, not silently reparented or bulk-cleaned. Delete is single-resource authorized tombstone with existing deliberate delete-wins compatibility for HTTP/sync; refuse live children/dependencies unless explicitly tombstoned separately first, no recursive cross-project destruction. Repeated bound sync uses existing samekey/receipt, differentkey same tombstone stable noop; HTTP existing owned tombstone same stable noop. No new restore endpoint/retention garbage collection, no optional general DAG activation. Candidate modal preserves IDs and original read baselines, explicit removal lists; restored legacy drafts without provable baseline rejected409, not silently rebound to freshserver.
D-S01-08.excluded: General DAG/custom roles/historical cleanup optional/other planned tasks remain separate.

Explicit deletedTaskIds/deletedMilestoneIds only legal delete intent; all changed-child aggregates exact baseUpdatedAt and each existing update item baseUpdatedAt for child CAS. New records server-generated IDs, never hard delete/recreate. Current actor/version/grants + project/member capability rechecked inside locked command. No new restore endpoint/retention garbage collection, no optional general DAG activation. T-RP-07.compatibility: Extends deliberate existing syncdeletewins to scopedHTTPtask tombstone; aggregateediting strictreadbase and updateschildCAS, no oldarray omission-delete. No deployed client catalog claim; safe409 on unproven draft/base.

Explicit deletedTaskIds/deletedMilestoneIds only legal delete intent; all changed-child aggregates exact baseUpdatedAt and each existing update item baseUpdatedAt for child CAS. New records server-generated IDs, never hard delete/recreate. Current actor/version/grants + project/member capability rechecked inside locked command. T-RP-06.rules: Revalidate same transaction, no skipDuplicates; dependency-sorted actual insert/update/delete counts and unchanged classification. Append-only identical rows unchanged, divergent reject. All writes/payload integrity verified before commit then exact manifest/row-count verified under held global restore gate before READY. Commit-before-check crash/fault remains RESTORE_NEEDS_RECONCILIATION with persisted runId/expected manifest; no false rollback or auto rerestore. Current active SUPER/version checked under lock. No last-copy audit/receipt delete. Additive DataRecoveryState and triggers coordinate prior admitted writes via row shared locks and block subsequent business writes/other restore; only matching internal transaction run can apply/check. Reconcile clears gate only after exact bound state verifies, no arbitrary approval override. Whole DB/file/target separate.
T-RP-06.compatibility: Existing merge/update patch compatible subject to schema constraints; stricter appendonly/replace failclosed. Preserve gate and evidence on rollback; incompatible old binary prohibited until approved candidate.

T-RP-10.rules: Any successful module restore atomically creates new UUID epoch, increments current users securityVersion floor and revokes all existing refresh rows (no deletion). JSON existing users retain current authentication fields/passwordHash/status/rank/forced/deleted/lock/version; profile data can restore. New imported users use unguessable disabled login secret, PENDING_ACTIVATION/MEMBER/forcedchange and no bindings, never copied credentials. Existing RBAC module restoration remains explicit SUPER intent but all old sessions revoked/re-auth authorized. JWT/refresh/SyncDevice/MutationReceipt bind epoch; old keys/receipt records retained and rejected cross-epoch, never moved/new-key retried. Cursor/ACL binds epoch, stale old dataset rejects/reset candidate client. DB statement shared gate blocks restore against prior writers; request-scoped expected epoch fence at every public ORM query/transaction prevents late previously authenticated request from writing postrestore. Callback and public batch tx preserve atomicity; descriptors not private Prisma APIs. Worker directDB without HTTPsession is trusted producer guarded by DB restore-state triggers. Only exact initiating pre-restore SUPER token may perform GETrestore/status or POSTrestore/reconcile during known pending own run and original version/epoch; no business/login/refresh bypass, no new credential revival. Automatic reconcile uses known postrestore initiating version. Gate not cleared on epoch/security/receipt failure. Frontend actor-owned queue original payload/key/device/binding retained; old/unproven dataset original isolated even manual sync, current cache/ACL/cursor reset atomically with dataset metadata, device namespace rotates for newepoch only, no anonymous cleanup or rebase. Native and Chrome prove actual states; no quota/target/wholeDR assertion.
T-RP-10.compatibility: Existing JWT missing epoch must reauthenticate; candidate frontend can carry new signed epoch. Native v1 receipts remain same format, reject olddataset binding. Existing deployed client catalog remains unknown and cannot certify release compatibility. Additive schema and security fields retained on rollback, no unsafe old binary activation.

T-RP-04.rules: Select ADR option3: seven source model AFTER DML triggers capture exact row/resource revision/epoch/source project/author/tombstone in same source tx, including HTTP/sync/template/import/restore/direct DML/cascades. Resource revisions atomic per epoch/entity/id. Publisher on demand, same owned/HTTP epoch fence, one transactional publication-head lock assigns transactional BigInt visible sequence (not nextval/MAX), immutable event payload, one-time publishing only, failures rollback. New epoch bootstrap SHARE locks all seven source tables before capturing existing snapshot, no producer head locks. On-demand no background process claimed. Current-epoch pages read latest authorized captured revision in fixed published cut, perpage current ACL/fresh actor/version, own reports, scalar whitelist projection (v2 project nested manager omitted, ordinary legacy remains), current metadata scope recheck before returning historical body. Revision-collapse prevents late publication old event regression. V2 signed checkpoint/page binds actor/device/epoch/ACL; final IDB publish only. Bad/old epoch/retained-floor cursor explicit RESET_REQUIRED retaining all owner originals. Retain all journal rows without automatic GC (floor0); no invented target offline window. Existing legacy timestamp pulls always full resnapshot, ignore timestamp lower bound; existing signed keyset remains compatible, not a commit watermark. Candidate frontend selects v2 and retains full atomic reset/replay semantics. Local conservative 10000 unpublished rows cap causes explicit503/rollback, target budget/producer trigger overhead external release gate. No optional DAG/delete rule changes, D-S01-08 condition false. No target/client catalog/operational SLO claims.

T-RP-08.rules: ALLOWED_ORIGINS primary/CORS_ORIGINS legacy normalized aliases, contradictions/malformed origins reject, no wildcard/null credentials in production. App and compiled CLI share exact loadConfig schema; no DB/network at CLI/import. strictproduction/staging valid postgresDB/DIRECT URLs, strongsecret and loopbackhost/port, absolute uploads out code, actual localstorage only. Development test import allows absent DB/secret. Exportflag deprecated ignoredfalse accepted, true reject as unsupported no fictitious protection: moduleJSON export remains existing audited SUPER policy, no semantic toggle/newrestore approval. Actual auth Bearer/access+JSONrefresh only; VITE_AUTH_MODE cookie reject. Unconsumed TRUST_PROXY_HOPS2 rejected, default1 deprecated not trusted security guarantee; MAXUPLOAD_MB only display budget no backend claim. Candidate exact source +dependency +build fingerprints/compiled CLI gate before migration; retain manifests, pre-DDL prepare failure no DB/current changes. No installs or git/network in this session; prepared candidate dependencies operator external.

T-RP-09.rules: Reuse full actual approved Bearer access/body refresh/session-generation policy; no cookie transport activation, no TTL/security/role change. CORS credentials false because no cookies; candidate variables consistent and CLI rejects unsupported cookie claims.

T-RP-13.rules: Kernel process lease serializes deploy/baseline/CAS/cleanup; no live lock stealing. Prepared candidate source/output/config/migration hash verified again; each migration exact compatibility entry and newapp post-DDL compatibility required, unknown denies before effects. Existing current baseline compared under lock, atomic sameFS temp pointer replace; build identity immutable health/ready/smoke. Mandatory stopWrites/pairedBackup before DDL; migration invoked means schemaMayHaveChanged even failure, never fakepreDDLrollback. Firstsafe no certified securityFloorSafe compatible old manifest => maintenance/stopWrites+stopService preserves candidate/current/schema/backups; never dangerous old release. Certified rollback requires exact artifact+allnewmigration backwardscompatible, restart/health matching that build; failedrollback staysmaintenance and nonzero. No migrate down/seed/destructive cleanup. Observe3 exact readiness/health plus1 smoke; latency/lag/queue/capacity operational budget and realtarget probes external; release input required before --apply. Local FS fixture hooks are SIMULATED_CONTROL not target production evidence. Preserve failure artifacts/releases; no cleanupautomatic. Secretfree phase metadata, all statesdurable and terminalfailure nonzero.

implementationRefinements.counts: Each durable reservation or push attempt consumes one; per-item query at most once per sync run. Explicit user action may query original binding only; never new key/re-reserve uncertain old intent.

implementationRefinements.reason: Owned barrier proved Serializable snapshot first established by user lock may retain membership removed before project-lock admission. Writer uses ReadCommitted with actor/target users sorted, project and current actor membership locks; current grants/account/member/capability read after those locks. Stage competitors serialize on project lock. Read projection RepeatableRead snapshot unchanged. No broad isolation downgrade outside registration.

implementationRefinements.rules: Existing milestones.delete alone activated for planned explicit milestone tombstones. No other P1/customroles/DAG activation; no default ordinary role grant. Additive permission record only migration, preserve row on rollback and pause feature. P0=90/P1manifest30 unchanged; SUPER includesunfrozen, ordinary roles requireexplicit grant+projectdelete capability. Native fixture must prove this seed/bootstrap resource before rejection cases.

implementationRefinements.reason: Source-bound public epoch facade requires owned native tx barrier fixtures; all original assertions kept. Candidate draft keys epoch-specific, physical originals preserved, no automatic rekey. New unapplied migration sorting fixed; old histories/failure logs frozen.

implementationRefinements.rules: Reuse full RP16-T03 dataset epoch contract; append durable owner source revision/tombstone marker and complete signed recovery pagination in existing allowed client files.

Owned actual openrsync2.6.9-compatible link-dest control preserves wrong mode after source644→640 and truncates nanosecond timestamps. Choose safe copytree/copy2 + explicit UID/GID source metadata validation before publication; dedupe with OS hardlink only when full hash+mode+uid/gid+mtimeNS+size identical and sameFS. Never chmod shared published inode. Retention config validate before any dump or publication.

implementationRefinements.scope: Only new guarded synthetic target, exact users/policy catalog, current authfloor from same owned source. Runtime production restore disabled/unknown; existing published pair NOT_VERIFIED unchanged.
